crossRefs.note: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.
They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.
As soon as we had heard it, our hearts melted, and there wasn’t any more spirit in any man, because of you: for Yahweh…
They said to Joshua, “Truly Yahweh has delivered all the land into our hands. Moreover, all the inhabitants of the land…
Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.
Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be.
He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and…
I will strengthen them in Yahweh; and they will walk up and down in his name,” says Yahweh.
that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his…
I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.

translations.web: My soul is weary with sorrow: strengthen me according to your word.
translations.bsb: My soul melts with sorrow; strengthen me according to Your word.
translations.kjv: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
translations.asv: My soul melteth for heaviness: Strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
